title: eludite/project/addExisting
description: Add existing files to a project (Add > Existing Item..., brief 0072; host-rpc.md, "Templates and items"). Without `link` each file is copied into the folder (a file already there is refused; a file already in the folder is left as it is) and a legacy project gets a `Compile` or `Content` item per copy. With `link` nothing is copied: the project gains `<Compile Include="<path relative to the project>" Link="<folder>\<name>" />` (`None` for other files). Project edits keep formatting; when the project file changed the solution reloads.

files.description: The files as the project now sees them: the copies, or the linked originals.
